//: Story Phase 2, chapter 3: Blackbeard's Treasure Room. Treasure hold: door spawn (9,12), Garrick (10,12), gold piles (8-11,7), fallen chest (15-16,10) goes to (12-13,11).
ch3.begin: hale: Captain! A word. Last night's swell shifted things in the treasure room. Quill heard chests sliding about.
hale[concerned]: Somebody ought to check the hoard and set it straight. Everyone else is needed on the rigging before the wind turns.
garrick[delighted]: The treasure room? Captain, I'd be DELIGHTED to assist. A full inventory audit, free of charge!
hale: He does have a strong back, Captain. Well. A wide one.

then: hale: We killed the rats yesterday, Captain. On your orders.
hale: I have the watch, Captain. And a bad back. And a finely tuned sense of self-preservation.

ch3.begin: captain[determined]: Guzzlegut. The treasure room door, in the cargo hold. You wait for me there.
hale[concerned]: ...He was rubbing his hands, Captain.
ch3.meet_at_door: garrick[greedy]: Captain! I've been standing here eleven minutes, imagining. It's been the best eleven minutes of my life.
captain: Rules. One: you touch nothing. Two: you touch nothing. Three—

start: Twelve years of plunder. Gold in drifts. Jewels by the bowlful. A crown for every day of the week.
captain[smug]: Behold, Guzzlegut. The treasure of Captain Blackbeard.
garrick[delighted]: Oh, Captain. It's beautiful. The craftsmanship. The weight. The resale value.
garrick[greedy]: I think I'm going to cry. I think I'm going to cry INTO it.
garrick[nervous]: The rule. Yes. The rule. The very... sensible... rule...
garrick: Just counting, Captain! One gold, two gold, three gold... it's all here! It's all LOVELY!
search: garrick[offended]: Captain, I resent the implication.
garrick[pretend]: Those were already in my pocket. Coincidence.
garrick: Ah. The ruby. I was keeping it warm. Rubies are very sensitive to temperature.
garrick[businesslike]: A necklace. For scale. You can't appraise properly without a reference piece.
garrick[offended]: That one's MINE. I brought it from home.
captain: You came from a bathtub.
captain[angry]: And a STATUE. How did you fit a statue in your coat?
garrick[businesslike]: Proprietary methodology, Captain. I'm afraid I can't disclose it.
captain[angry]: One more stunt like that and you're back in the bathtub. With ONE sausage.
garrick[pretend]: Ignore that. The room has... acoustics.
captain: Now. Let's see what the swell did to my hoard.

ch3.inspect_hoard: The hoard has mostly ridden out the swell. A few piles have slumped and a crown has rolled under the strongbox...
...and one chest has slid clean off the stack by the starboard wall. It's lying on its side.
captain: Guzzlegut. That chest. You're lifting the other end.
garrick[pretend]: Heavy lifting. Right. I'd like it on record that I'm management.

then: A heavy chest, knocked off the stack by the swell. You'll want a second pair of hands for this.

start: garrick: Is it lift ON three, or three and THEN lift?
garrick[gastro]: I'm lifting, Captain. Everything's lifting. Things are lifting that shouldn't be lifting.
rumble: The biggest rumble yet. Coins slide off the piles. A candelabra hums. Somewhere, a crown falls off its cushion.
Something small and leathery flies out from under Garrick and lands in the gold with a soft clink.
garrick[terrified]: It came off, Captain. On its own.
captain[alarmed]: THEN BOTH OF US! OUT! NOW!

then: The door won't budge. Something is clamped onto the handle.

ch3.door_locked: garrick[businesslike]: We haven't finished the audit, Captain!
captain: Nobody leaves until that chest is back on the stack.
